en.topic_title: 3 re-arrested for alleged sedition after marking anniversary of 2019 Prince Edward police storming
en.topic_summary:
Police have re-arrested three people on suspicion of sedition, after previously apprehending them outside Prince Edward station on the anniversary of a 2019 incident when police stormed MTR trains on the platform.



Prince Edward MTR station on August 31, 2019. Photo: May James/HKFP.
